mechanics.claim: The shockwave stuns nearby enemies and pulls them inward over a set distance.
mechanics.quote: deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, and {{tip|airborne|pulls}} them over 325 units

mechanics.claim: The ability casts from wherever the champion is at the end of the cast time, not at cast start, even beyond max tether range.
mechanics.quote: ''Command: Shockwave'' will cast from wherever the unit the ''The Ball'' is attached to is at the end of the cast time, even if the unit exceeds max tether range.

mechanics.claim: Displacement immunity does not prevent the stun from being applied.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Displacement immunity}} will not resist the application of the {{tip|stun}}.

mechanics.claim: The ability can be blocked by a spell shield.
